\@^#define MARKER_PIXEL(col, row) (x + (col) + g_framebuffer_width \* ((row) + 225) + 200)$@s/225/224/
\@^#define MARKER_PIXEL(col, row) (x + (col) + g_framebuffer_width \* ((row) + 225) + 200)$@s/200)/201)/
\@^#define MARKER_PIXEL(col, row) (x + (col) + g_framebuffer_width \* ((row) + 225) + 200)$@s/g_framebuffer_width \* ((row) + 225)/320 * ((row) + 225)/
\#^    u16 \*other = (u16 \*) g_framebuffers\[g_dl_buf_index == 0\];$#s/== 0/!= 0/
\#^    u16 \*aux = (u16 \*) g_zbuffer;$#s/g_zbuffer/g_framebuffers[1]/
\#^    for (col = 0; col < 8; col++) {$#s/col < 8/col < 7/
\#^        other\[MARKER_PIXEL(col, 0)\] = 0xF800;$#s/0xF800/0xF801/
\#^        aux\[MARKER_PIXEL(col, 0)\] = 0;$#d
\#^    for (row = 1; row < 7; row++) {$#s/row < 7/row < 6/
\#^        for (col = 0; col < 8; col += 7) {$#s/col += 7/col += 6/
\#^            current\[MARKER_PIXEL(col, row)\] = 0xF800;$#s/0xF800/0/
\#^        for (col = 1; col < 7; col++) {$#s/col = 1/col = 2/
\#^            other\[MARKER_PIXEL(col, row)\] = 0;$#d
\#^            aux\[MARKER_PIXEL(col, row)\] = 0;$#s/0;/0xF800;/
\#^        current\[MARKER_PIXEL(col, 7)\] = 0xF800;$#s/7)/6)/
\#^        aux\[MARKER_PIXEL(col, 7)\] = 0;$#s/aux/other/
